description: The output formats the terminal on the `mov new` tab is allowed to show. Every line and prompt in src/tui.js has to match one of these, and verify/check.py fails the build on one that matches none. Each entry names the mov source that prints it, so when mov's wording changes this is the one file to update and the source says where to look. The coupling is by reference: the two repositories cannot see each other's tests, and this file is the honest substitute.

formats.source: mov/src/mov/cli.py  new: the stages line under the write
mov/src/mov/cli.py  new: the two typer.confirm prompts, answered
mov/src/mov/runner.py  the stage heading: n/total name summary

formats.pattern: ^ {5}would deploy mov-\S+( into a new resource group)?$

formats.source: mov/src/mov/stages/arm.py  the deployment name printed before create
